confirmed: Settings is Administrator-only for Organization sections; loaders redirect other roles and the API requires the administrator role.

Organization rail has Contracts, Matters, Entities, and Knowledge sections. Types tabs exist for all four; Statuses for Contracts and Matters; Fields for Contracts, Matters, and Entities; Officer roles for Entities.
Add type creates on Enter or blur. Rename, Edit (Contracts, Matters, Entities), reorder handle with arrow keys, Archive, Show archived, and Restore labels match messages.
Slug is immutable and shown in the type editor. Description saves on blur or Enter.
Archiving an in-use type requires a replacement and moves the records; Other is protected on Contract, Matter, and Entity types and Officer roles.
Contract Status Stages and protected Draft, Active, and Expired seeds; Stage floor; no reassignment in the Contract Status dialog.
Matter Status Categories Open and Closed are protected; each Category keeps a live Status; in-use archive needs a same-Category replacement.
Field dialog labels Name, Description, Type, Scope, Tag (Business, Legal), Options, AI prompt (Contract scope only); Type is immutable after creation.
Promotion to Global and refused narrowing while another module attaches the Field.
Field catalog has no reorder handles; Field archive keeps attachments and values.
Type editor Attached fields, Attach field, Required checkbox, Detach, and reorder; requiredness enforced at creation and re-type.
Officer role archive reassigns current and resigned appointments; Other cannot be archived.
Contract type catalog excludes the built-in Owning department and Region attributes; this does not change any article step.
notCovered: The Contract type editor now has a People card (default people, CTR-026). The article does not describe it. No section was added because this batch does not add sections for features the article did not cover.

corrections.after: Check Matter Manager. The dialog now starts with the person who opens it; choose another person or Unassigned to test a different Task assignment.

confirmed: Settings > Matters > Templates: Matter type select, Add template dialog with Name and Description, Edit link, Archive dialog Archive template, Show archived, Restore.

Editor sections and labels: Matter defaults (Priority, Risk, Title prefix), Custom field defaults, Tasks (Add task, due offset, Matter Manager or Unassigned role), Key dates (Add key date, label, offset, note), Save template.
Offsets are whole numbers 0 to 3650; a Task due offset may be blank; a Key date needs an offset.
Dates use the Matter creation date in UTC (civilToday on createdAt) for both direct creation and conversion.
A Matter Manager Task stays unassigned when the Matter has no manager.

Conversion: priority is the reviewed value or the Request Urgency, never the template default; risk is null; the converting person is Matter Manager; the title is the reviewed title without the template prefix; AI suggestions can prefill supported values.
Caller values override template defaults; a cleared optional Field is sent as null and stays empty (#770 fix, in the build); required Fields need values.
A template must be live and match the selected Matter type, or creation is refused.
Detached Field defaults are named in the editor as retained values.
Section save errors say earlier changes may already be saved.

confirmed: Settings > Intake > Request types and Deflection links tabs; Add request type on Enter; Edit opens the editor; Description saves on blur.
Every submission creates a Request; conversion or resolution is Legal's choice.
The request type editor hides the Slug and has no Target control.
Archive dialog shows no usage and no replacement for request types, because the mount has no usage counter; Requests keep the type; Show archived and Restore work.

Target turnaround (business days): whole number 0 to 36,500 or blank, saves on blur or Enter, counts Monday to Friday in the organization's timezone without public holidays; the Portal card shows Estimated turnaround.
Form fields: Attach field, Required checkbox, reorder handles with arrow keys, Detach keeps the catalog Field.
Department uses the Departments list under Settings > Organization and carries into the converted Contract or Matter without a Field attachment.

Deflection links: Add link, Target (External address with http:// or https:// Address, or Knowledge item), Label, Placement (Portal home or a request type), Edit, reorder, Remove with no archive; Portal shows Before you submit.
Convert dialog lists answers under Does not carry into the contract or matter when the destination type does not attach the Field; the answer stays on the Request.
An archived configured target type needs a live choice at conversion.

corrections.location: Set reminder lead times, paragraph after the limits
corrections.before: One list covers every tracked date.
corrections.after: The organization list applies to all tracked dates. Contract and Matter Key dates can add their own lead times and select recipients; a lead time in both lists fires once; expiry, notice deadlines, and Entity Obligations use only the organization list. Links to the Key date guides.

corrections.before: Multiple Key dates on one record on the same date can share a reminder.
corrections.after: Each Key date gets its own reminder, also when several share a date. Check the Key date's own lead times and selected recipients.

corrections.before: Checks listed date, lead time, timezone, record audience, and preferences.
corrections.after: Also check the Key date's selected recipients, because a nonempty selection replaces the default audience.

corrections.location: Find a change in the Audit log, scope paragraph; If an entry is missing
corrections.before: The Audit log includes all configuration and record-level events.
corrections.after: Entries about a Confidential Contract, Matter, Entity, or Document appear only when the Administrator is in that record's audience, and Export CSV applies the same limit. The missing-entry checks now include this.
corrections.source: apps/api/src/modules/audit-log/routes.ts auditReachScope applied to the list, paging cursor, and export

confirmed: Organization > Notifications opens Reminder lead times at /settings/reminders; Personal > Notifications is the person's own preferences.
Add lead time, days before the date, On the day for 0, Remove, reorder handle with arrow keys.
Lead times are distinct whole numbers 0 to 730, at most 20, and the last one cannot be removed.
The morning round runs hourly and serves each person once per local day after 08:00 in the saved timezone, UTC when unset.
Dates approaching In-app preference and the Dates and Obligations Briefing switches exist under Personal > Notifications.
Settings > Security > Audit log: Person, Action, Record, From, To, Search, Clear filters, Show older, Export CSV; columns Event, Record, Audience, When; read error text asks to change a filter.
Only Administrators open the Audit log and the reminder settings; the loader redirects others and the API requires the administrator role.
Entries now show the record reference and title where the record has them.
